artDirection: Premium painted HD-2D fantasy tactical RPG road-choice context in the canonical forest fork after combat. Reveal two plausible onward directions without choosing, labeling, or privileging either route.

shots.purpose: Reveal the cleared road opening onto the shrine-road and guarded-road alternatives.
shots.promptIntent: Kestrel advances a few careful steps screen-right after the resolved road fight and stops where both branches can be read. Preserve bow, hands, identity, and screen-right facing. Keep both routes neutral; add no enemies, signs, labels, markers, shrine conclusion, or selection.

shots.purpose: Continue the reviewed fork view and settle into a clean frame for the real route overlay.
shots.promptIntent: Continue from the reviewed chained frame using only breathing, leaves, mist, and distant atmospheric motion. Lock the camera and preserve the exact framing and subject scale: no push-in, pull-back, pan, zoom, crop, or reframing. Keep Kestrel and bow stable and screen-right-facing. End sharp with both road branches readable; never add UI, arrows, text, route markers, a chosen direction, or a new combat threat.
